title: Random Name Picker
description: Paste a list of names and draw one or more winners in the browser without sending the list to the server.
metaDescription: Paste a list of names and draw winners or shuffle the order in the browser, with safe links by default.

form.title: Draw names
form.description: Use a pasted list to draw winners, draw again, or shuffle all names.

input.title: List
input.label: Names or participants
input.privacy: The draw happens in your browser. This tool does not send the list to the server.
input.guidance: Use one name per line. Automatic mode also treats commas and semicolons as separators.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Choose winners or a shuffled order, and decide how repeated entries should behave.

quantity.label: Number of winners
quantity.help: The limit is 500. Without replacement, the quantity cannot exceed the available entries.

separator.label: Separator
separator.help: Line-by-line is more predictable; automatic helps with lists pasted from spreadsheets or messages.

toggles.noRepeatHelp: Draws without replacement and limits the total to the number of available entries.
toggles.removeDuplicatesHelp: Keeps the first typed version and makes each name count once.

share.title: Share
share.description: By default, the link stores only mode, quantity, and options. The list does not enter the URL.
share.includeContent: Include names in the shared link
share.safe: The current link does not include names or the draw result.
share.publicWarning: Links with names expose the list to anyone who receives the URL.
share.tooLong: The list is too large for a safe link. The link will include only settings and the content option.

validation.singleEntry: Add one more name to make a valid draw.
validation.summary: {count} entries available for the current mode.
validation.inputTooLong: The list exceeded the size limit and was read up to the allowed limit.
validation.entryTooLong: {count} very long entries were shortened for display.
validation.quantityCapped: Without replacement, the draw uses at most {count} available entries.
validation.duplicatesFound: {count} duplicates count as extra chances. Enable duplicate removal to count once.

result.title: Result
result.description: Each click creates a new random order; the result is not saved in the URL.
result.waiting: Fill the list to enable the draw.
result.ready: Click draw to generate the result.
result.capped: The quantity was capped because the no-repeat option is enabled.
result.disclaimer: Casual use only. This does not replace official raffle procedures, audits, legal authorization, or prize-promotion rules.

paste.title: Paste the list
paste.description: Enter one item per line or use automatic separators for lists with commas and semicolons.

repeat.title: Repeats and duplicates
repeat.description: Repeated names count more than once unless the duplicate removal option is enabled.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.description: The list stays in the browser. Include names in the shared link only when every recipient may see the list.

privacy.question: Is the list of names sent to the server?
privacy.answer: No. List parsing and drawing happen in the browser. The list only enters a link if you enable the include names option.

duplicates.question: Do repeated names count more than once?
duplicates.answer: Yes. By default, every repeated line is another chance. Enable duplicate removal when each name should count once.

multiple.question: Can I draw more than one winner?
multiple.answer: Yes. Enter the quantity you want. With no-repeat enabled, the draw caps the total at the number of available entries.

replacement.question: Can the draw repeat names?
replacement.answer: It can when the no-repeat option is off. When it is on, each selected entry leaves the current draw.

sharing.question: Can I share a draw with the list prefilled?
sharing.answer: Yes, but only by enabling the option to include names in the link. Those names are visible to anyone who receives the URL.

official.question: Is this picker valid for official raffles?
official.answer: No. It is a casual tool and does not create an audit log, record, integrity proof, legal authorization, or promotion compliance.

seo.about: The random name picker chooses winners or shuffles a list directly in the browser. It shows valid entries, duplicates, and ignored empty lines so the draw is easier to understand.
seo.howToUse: Paste the list, choose winners or shuffle mode, set the quantity, and click draw. Shared links preserve only settings by default; include the list only when it can be public to whoever receives the URL.
